tmpfs/loopback and synthetic drivers; no disk saturation, real SSH devices, WAN, power-loss or production capacity test
perf_2: poll delay and same-device queue latency
retention locks and full-source hydration/hash within one transaction
23505 claim collision handling; keep partial unique constraint
outage tolerance beyond grace, retry jitter/backoff and heartbeat fencing
physical disk/fsync, large multi-source artifacts, WAN FTPS and deployment Paramiko pin
